The following changes were implemented on September 5th, 2025:
  • Weapon was initially purchasable for 500 Gold, with a sellback of 50 Gold.

levelVariants.name: Blade of Revelry
levelVariants.stats: Crit +1, END +1, STR +1

levelVariants.name: Blade of Festivity
levelVariants.stats: Crit +2, END +2, STR +2
levelVariants.description: Festivities are in full swing all over Frostvale as the towns inhabitants celebrate your victory over Noxus and enjoy freedom from a carbon-bound existence. Moglin magic has imbued this sword with healing magic- a 5% chance to heal you!

levelVariants.name: Blade of Rejoicing
levelVariants.stats: Crit +2, END +3, STR +2
levelVariants.description: It is truly a time to rejoice, for your friends have been freed from Noxus cruel, coal-loving grasp. Carry this sword as a reminder of your victory and enjoy its healing powers: a 5% chance to heal you on a successful hit.

levelVariants.name: Blade of Delight
levelVariants.stats: Crit +2, END +2, STR +3
levelVariants.description: This sword's mirror-bright blade is sure to delight Frostval celebrants old and young. Another reason to celebrate: It has a chance to heal 5% of your life on a successful hit.

levelVariants.name: Blade of Wonder
levelVariants.stats: Dodge +1, Crit +3, END +3, STR +4, Bonus +1
levelVariants.description: This Blade of Wonder/ has an edge of light. / A sword of healing/ shining bright... Feel free to sing along as you carry this year's Frostval reward into battle in the coming months. It has a chance to heal 5% of your life on a successful hit.

levelVariants.name: Blade of Amusement
levelVariants.stats: Dodge +1, Crit +4, Magic Def +4, Pierce Def +4, Melee Def +4, WIS +6, END +6, CHA +6, LUK +6, STR +7, Bonus +5
levelVariants.description: This weapon is a fitting reminder of all the amusement that comes when you have fun and enjoy the little things. It has a chance to heal 5% of your life on a successful hit.

levelVariants.name: Blade of Kindness
levelVariants.stats: Dodge +2, Crit +6, Magic Def +5, Pierce Def +5, Melee Def +5, WIS +8, END +8, CHA +7, LUK +7, STR +9, Bonus +8
levelVariants.description: The Frostval season should be a reminder to everyone to be kind to everyone, even those that may not necessarily always deserve it. It has a chance to heal 5% of your life on a successful hit.

levelVariants.name: Blade of Forgiveness
levelVariants.stats: Dodge +3, Crit +7, Magic Def +7, Pierce Def +7, Melee Def +7, WIS +10, END +10, CHA +8, LUK +8, STR +12, Bonus +10
levelVariants.description: Forgiveness is a trait every hero should have no matter how dark the day is. Sometimes those that do the most wrong were themselves wronged the most. Never forget that. It has a chance to heal 5% of your life on a successful hit.

levelVariants.description:
CLICK ON THIS strange CorDemi item while holding it to change its shape to best suit you.

 This is the most basic version of the otherworldly weapon.
levelVariants.notes:
Transformed from Bloodember Meteorite (All Versions) on September 8th, 2006.
Weapon has a unique Magic inventory icon.
Weapon has an unknown, very low drop rate from select quests.
Weapon was initially available to purchase at Cysero's Shop until the release of Cysero's Superstore of Savings! on September 21st, 2007.
Possessing any CorDemi Codex weapon in a player's inventory will permit access to the Vend-tron 3000 (All Versions) shops;
  • Following implementation of Dragon Coin sellbacks in February 2008, only versions purchasable with Dragon Coins—or those which dropped prior to this time frame—would permit access; this was fixed in October 2008.
Weapon is animated; the symbol on the key's appearance pulsates between green and black continuously.
Click anywhere on the weapon to see and hear it change between its Key, Sword, Dagger, and Staff appearances;
  • Each appearance will change the weapon to its corresponding item type (Key acts as a Sword), however its damage type is locked to Melee.
  • If shown, changing the weapon into a key will compress the equipped weapon's damage range to 10% of its original values, rounded up.
  • If shown, changing the weapon into a dagger will change the equipped weapon's item type, allowing Rogue-based classes to dual wield any weapon upon hiding the CorDemi Codex.
Weapon was previously available from the retired quest Sneevil Box Fort.

  • Following implementation of Dragon Coin sellbacks in February 2008, only versions purchasable with Dragon Coins—or those which dropped prior to this time frame—would permit access; this was fixed in October 2008.
Weapon is animated; the symbol on the key's appearance pulsates between green and black continuously.
Click anywhere on the weapon to see and hear it change between its Key, Sword, Dagger, and Staff appearances;
  • Each appearance will change the weapon to its corresponding item type (Key acts as a Sword), however its damage type is locked to Melee.
  • If shown, changing the weapon into a key will compress the equipped weapon's damage range to 10% of its original values, rounded up.
  • If shown, changing the weapon into a dagger will change the equipped weapon's item type, allowing Rogue-based classes to dual wield any weapon upon hiding the CorDemi Codex.
Weapon was previously available from the retired quest Spirits in the Inn.

shared.description: Heroes all over Lore celebrate loyalty each time they pick up this sword and battle in wars and quests with each other. For loyalty and Lore, chaaaarge!
shared.notes:
Weapons' special will cause a red, white, or blue outline to appear around the target when activated, respective to the element of the DoT effect applied.
Weapons' special has a 10% chance to activate, thus a special of a specific element effectively has a ~3.33% chance to apply.
Weapons' special may activate multiple times in a single turn, however specials will overwrite one another, and do not stack; only the most recently applied DoT will remain active.
  • Weapons' special became mutually exclusive from the following On-Hit DoT specials from the following weapons; this was implemented on September 8th, 2023:
    • 'DOOM': Corrupt ShadowReaper of Doom, Corrupt Skullstaff of Doom, Corrupt Twin Blades of Doom, Unreal ShadowReaper of Doom, Unreal Skullstaff of Doom, Unreal Twin Blades of Doom
    • 'Destiny': Penultimate Blinding Light of Destiny, Penultimate DragonStaff of Destiny, Penultimate Twin Blades of Destiny, Ultimate Blinding Light of Destiny, Ultimate DragonStaff of Destiny, Ultimate Twin Blades of Destiny
    • 'Destroyer's Spirit': Var'Dolaas
    • 'Spirit of Ice' (and thus all 'Spirit' effects): Brave Blade, Bright Star Staff, Dagger of Unity, Freedom, Independence, Liberty, Mace of the North, Pick of the North, Staff of the North, Staff of Unity, Star Spangled Sword, Sword of Unity, Wheel of Greed and Envy

shared.description: Freedom is recognized all over this region of Lore as a weapon symbolizing the equality of all people.
shared.notes:
Weapons' special will cause a red, white, or blue outline to appear around the target when activated, respective to the element of the DoT effect applied.
Weapons' special has a 10% chance to activate, thus a special of a specific element effectively has a ~3.33% chance to apply.
Weapons' special may activate multiple times in a single turn, however specials will overwrite one another, and do not stack; only the most recently applied DoT will remain active.
  • Weapons' special became mutually exclusive from the following On-Hit DoT specials from the following weapons; this was implemented on September 8th, 2023:
    • 'DOOM': Corrupt ShadowReaper of Doom, Corrupt Skullstaff of Doom, Corrupt Twin Blades of Doom, Unreal ShadowReaper of Doom, Unreal Skullstaff of Doom, Unreal Twin Blades of Doom
    • 'Destiny': Penultimate Blinding Light of Destiny, Penultimate DragonStaff of Destiny, Penultimate Twin Blades of Destiny, Ultimate Blinding Light of Destiny, Ultimate DragonStaff of Destiny, Ultimate Twin Blades of Destiny
    • 'Destroyer's Spirit': Var'Dolaas
    • 'Spirit of Light' (and thus all 'Spirit' effects): Decus, Ferocitas, Fidelitas, Wheel of Greed and Envy

description: This large sword is amazingly light and well balanced, but requires a Dragon Amulet to wield. A special process was used to prepare the magic blade adding a purple tint to it.
notes:
Weapon is a reference to the McDonaldland character Grimace.
Weapon was initially available to purchase at Cysero's Shop until the release of Cysero's Superstore of Savings! on September 21st, 2007.

name: Grom's Monster Sword of the Vengeful Eye
description: The eye on this sword keeps a careful watch for monsters.
notes:
While weapon's exact location is unknown due to inconclusive documentation, it is plausible that it was obtained at random from a bag hidden in a quest, similarly to Beserker Blade of Carnage from the Fire Cave quest during the DragonFable Beta.
Due to inconclusive documentation, weapon's name has also been reported as potentially being 'Grom's Master Sword of the Vengeful Eye'.

name: Grown Blade
description: This sword was an experiment by a mad weaponsmith. It was grown rather than forged and needs to be watered daily.
